t: The Bulldozer Dustpan & Brush Set offers efficient cleaning for both indoor and outdoor environments. Its robust polypropylene construction and polyethylene terephthalate bristles allow for greater durability. The handbrush features combined stiff and soft flagged synthetic bristles, effective in wet and dry conditions, capturing fine dust and larger debris. An integrated scraper tip tackles stubborn dirt, complemented by a soft handle grip for comfort. The dustpan includes a moulded rubber lip for effective surface contact and serrated edges to easily clean brush fibres, making general sweeping tasks straightforward.
